project_type: Next.js 16.2.1 App Router with React 19, white-label health coaching SaaS
build_system: npm + Next.js bundler (no Makefile). React Compiler enabled.
test_framework: Vitest for unit tests (existing). Playwright to be added for E2E.
test_command: npm run test:e2e (to be created; runs `playwright test`)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run test:e2e` and confirm all tests pass. 2. Run `npm run build` and confirm no TS errors.
setup_instructions: 1. `npm install` 2. Create .env.local with CLIENT_ID=arsh-sandhu and dummy Supabase creds (demo mode bypasses). 3. `npm run dev` starts on port 3000.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to npm and Playwright browser downloads. No Supabase connection needed since tests use ?demo=true for authenticated pages.
contribution_requirements: Never hardcode config values in tests - import from site.config.ts. Follow patterns in ai-context/coding-standards/correct-patterns.md. Never mock Supabase in E2E tests.
key_patterns: Demo mode: append ?demo=true to bypass auth on coach/client pages. Config: all brand/pricing/coach values come from site.config.ts via @/lib/config. Pages use Suspense + useSearchParams pattern. Landing page is client-specific (clients/arsh-sandhu/landing.tsx).
directory_structure: clients/ - per-client configs and landing pages. src/app/ - Next.js App Router pages. src/app/(coach)/coach/ - coach portal pages. src/app/(client)/client/ - client portal pages. src/lib/ - utilities, DB functions, auth context. src/components/ - shared UI components.
